stage0092_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$エンジェル$$...!
　If you can see $$ビッグオー$$, come out!
　I want to talk with you!」

stage0092_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Military Police
「That black Megadeus... what is it doing?」

stage0092_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ダストン$$
「I don't know.
　But let him do as he likes.」

stage0092_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ダストン$$
（$$ロジャー$$...
　I believe in your pride.）

stage0092_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, Master $$ロジャー$$... will it go well?」

stage0092_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you've come out, the Big!
　Proxy of the System!」

stage0092_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「She says she doesn't want to see you,
　$$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0092_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$...!」

stage0092_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Yes... this legion of the Big
　is her will to refuse.」

stage0092_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see...
　So this is her answer, in place of words...」

stage0092_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then removing it by force can be
　called a proper negotiation.」

stage0092_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$桂$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Mister Negotiator.」

stage0092_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$モーム$$
「Shall we get to work, $$ロジャー$$?」

stage0092_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$宗介$$
「Crushing that legion, is it...
　But that logic just now seems forced.」

stage0092_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「There is nothing in my heart to be ashamed of.
　Therefore, you are not guilty.」

stage0092_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't really get it,
　but this way suits us better.」

stage0092_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$タケル$$
「So to escape Paradigm City,
　we have to defeat that legion, right?」

stage0092_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「When you get down to it, yes.」

stage0092_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But be careful.
　In '《$$メトロポリス$$》', the Big is said to have
　burned every world as a legion of god.」

stage0092_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$葵$$
「I've gotten used to that type of opponent lately.」

stage0092_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「I wonder, can you all manage it?」

stage0092_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シン$$, $$バナージ$$...
　Don't think about anything unnecessary now.」

stage0092_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト$$ must be watching our fight...」

stage0092_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$n
「I can't afford to lose in front of him...!」

stage0092_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Now then, everyone...!
　Join me a while, before the truth comes to light!」

stage0092_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Witness the end of a pitiful man, possessed
　by an endless dream of the world's truth...!」

stage0092_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$...!」

stage0092_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Now, let's begin!
　...no, let's end it!」

stage0092_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「The world will soon be reborn!
　The end itself is the gateway to a new world!」

stage0092_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アルト$$
「Does this mean we can go back to our world now?」

stage0092_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's not it.
　It's the other party in my negotiation.」

stage0092_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Be careful, $$ロジャー$$.
　Something's coming.」

stage0092_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ソーラーアクエリオン$$!
　$$カグラ$$!?」

stage0092_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I've come, $$アマタ$$!
　To crush you!」

stage0092_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$桂$$
「To think he'd chase us across dimensions...!
　Just how much power does that guy have!」

stage0092_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not $$カグラ$$ moving Aquarion right now...!
　It's a far darker will!」

stage0092_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This is... a feeling of hatred!」

stage0092_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$刹那$$
「A fierce rejection that can never be understood...!
　This is...!」

stage0092_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　If that's how you want it...!」

stage0092_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Not bad resolve, for you!
　But listen! $$シルフィ$$ is mine!!」

stage0092_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Like I'd ever accept something like that!?」

stage0092_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll go beyond fate itself and
　embrace the here and now!
　$$ミコノ$$-saaaan!!」

stage0092_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Ah, a voice in my head...!?）

stage0092_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（To deny the fight is to deny
　this whole world along with it...）

stage0092_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（You're not combining with those two,
　you're combining with me,
　$$ミコノ・スズシロ$$...）

stage0092_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（You're not $$ゼシカ$$...!
　Who are you!?）

stage0092_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Heh... My name is Love's Loser...）

stage0092_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Holding onto that hatred, I fought
　Apollo, thought to be Apollonius
　reincarnated）

stage0092_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（But the love still smoldering
　could not be completely erased）

stage0092_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（When the Tree of Life collapsed, Apollo
　wished to become one with me to save
　the world, and I accepted it）

stage0092_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（And when those people tried once more to
　remake the world as they wished, Apollo
　and I sought to become one, deeper still...）

stage0092_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（To become one with the one I love...
　I felt ecstasy, rapture...）

stage0092_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（But then I realized it. In the moment
　our souls melted together, that Apollo
　was not Apollonius reincarnated...!）

stage0092_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Not once, but twice...
　Apollonius trampled my feelings underfoot!）

stage0092_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（I will destroy this world and become the god of a new one.
　Love's Loser will destroy all love...
　That is the new myth I seek...）

stage0092_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Now, let us become one.
　No matter how many times I kill you,
　it's never enough, you thief of Apollonius!）

stage0092_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（This is our wedding of vengeance!）

stage0092_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ahh, hatred is welling up
　from the depths of my heart!」

stage0092_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This sandbox those people left behind...
　And the system that returns all to nothing...!
　I will fulfill my desire before it activates!」

stage0092_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Is that thing possessing $$ゼシカ$$!?」

stage0092_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You bastard!
　Give $$ミコノ$$ baaaack!!」

stage0092_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't think a mere wing dog
　can defy a god's machine.」

stage0092_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$!
　Don't do as you please!!」

stage0092_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「As I please?
　This Wings of the sun is mine now.」

stage0092_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$カグラ$$, you cannot defy me.
　Now then, shall we go?」

stage0092_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ahh...!
　How beautiful... and yet so empty!」

stage0092_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now then, let us begin.
　The eve before a new myth begins...
　in other words, destruction.」

stage0092_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「You went and called in the $$ケルビム兵$$!?」

stage0092_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... this is
　the power of a god.」

stage0092_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just because you're wearing black
　doesn't mean you can get this cocky...!」

stage0092_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I cannot allow lawlessness in this city.
　We'll intercept Aquarion.」

stage0092_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Both of you! Answer me!」

stage0092_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's pointless.
　The Wings of the sun have fallen
　fully into my hands.」

stage0092_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Hahaha! It's not those people's power
　that will return you to nothing!
　It's I!」

stage0092_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「This isn't Altair, so what's going on!?」

stage0092_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This sandbox is an object of my hatred...
　And I hold two great triangles of hatred besides.」

stage0092_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That is what gives me power.
　Yes... infinite power!」

stage0092_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That is the power of a god, wingless...!」

stage0092_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$桂$$
「Look who's talking, wanting to destroy
　the world just because he got dumped.」

stage0092_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$宗介$$
「It seems even that 'power of a god' of yours
　couldn't make the one you wanted look your way.」

stage0092_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Be silent, wingless one.
　...The memory of miserable defeat that remains
　within me... it's what gives me strength now.」

stage0092_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And now, the System they left behind,
　the source of it all, appears right here!」

stage0092_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ミカゲ$$!
　Do you have some connection to whoever built that!?」

stage0092_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have no intention of answering.
　That's no concern of yours, wingless one.」

stage0092_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アルト$$
「Then I'll force the answer out of you!」

stage0092_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Wait, $$アルト$$!
　Something more is coming out!」

stage0092_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「A negative existence...
　One that does not belong to this world.」

stage0092_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahaha!
　So you've finally... come!」

stage0092_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「See you, $n...
　This is the answer she reached at despair's end.」

stage0092_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Oh, but if it's farewell,
　I'll have to say it to this whole world.」

stage0092_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's not a retreat...!
　That is... annihilation!」

stage0092_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's the power of that colorless $$ビッグオー$$...!」

stage0092_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A bit regrettable, but it seems time's up.
　Now, let me watch you all be swallowed by the System.」

stage0092_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ビッグヴィヌス$$...
　A bird stripped of its wings...」

stage0092_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A beast, before its evolution into a bird...」

stage0092_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$エンジェル$$...
　So you're the one piloting it.」

stage0092_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I came here to talk with you.」

stage0092_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Are you saying you won't listen?」

stage0092_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$五飛$$
「If we let it run free, this city will be erased!」

stage0092_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「And if it were to appear in our world too...!」

stage0092_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If that happens...!
　The world would...!」

stage0092_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Something someone prepared
　to reset the world's existence...）

stage0092_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Are you saying that when the 12,000-year
　cycle closes, it means to grant the despairing
　peace in the name of nothingness...!）

stage0092_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$赤木$$
「What'll you do, $$ロジャー$$!
　Use your usual trick!?」

stage0092_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But that's merely one step toward negotiation.」

stage0092_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll leave the finish to you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0092_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$キラ$$
「Come to think of it, this happened before.」

stage0092_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$シン$$
「We managed it back then too!
　And this time as well...!」

stage0092_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But it has the power to erase our existence...!」

stage0092_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$隼人$$
「Mere contact isn't the issue...!
　If it turns its attention to us, we're erased!」

stage0092_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So dodging or toughing out its attacks
　makes no difference either way!」

stage0092_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「In other words, each of us gets
　only one chance to attack!」

stage0092_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Regardless of the outcome, anyone
　who fights it will be erased!」

stage0092_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「It's not annihilation.
　Our existence is only held in another dimension.」

stage0092_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「A kind of quantum theory...!」

stage0092_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Don't quite get it, but we won't die, huh!」

stage0092_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ロジャー$$ will surely bring your existence back.」

stage0092_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So whether we exist depends on his negotiation.」

stage0092_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$桂$$
「I trust your skill at the negotiating table.」

stage0092_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now choose, wingless one.
　Be erased by the System,
　or be torn apart by me.」

stage0092_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll just do all we can!」

stage0092_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units!
　Whether we can escape Paradigm City
　depends on $$ロジャー$$'s negotiation!」

stage0092_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Ignore the black Aquarion!
　Pour everything we've got into that $$ビッグヴィヌス$$!」

stage0092_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Each of us only gets one chance to attack!
　Dodging or defending won't change the outcome!」

stage0092_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ロジャー$$...
　You alone should be spared from annihilation.」

stage0092_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So $$ビッグオー$$ and I become the last trump card.」

stage0092_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm counting on you, everyone...!
　Lend me your strength, to bring
　her to the negotiating table!」

stage0092_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$甲児$$
「But in exchange, we'll count on you for the finish!」

stage0092_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then here we go, $$エンジェル$$!
　Such a tasteless outfit doesn't suit you!」

stage0092_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Here I come! $$エンジェル$$!!」

stage0092_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
???
「Fate does not change.
　Not by human hands.」

stage0092_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$エンジェル$$!
　Can you hear my voice!」

stage0092_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I won't ask what drove you to despair!」

stage0092_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's all in the past now.
　The memory... and this city's birth too.」

stage0092_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「This city is an illusion named eternity...
　And so are we, who live here...」

stage0092_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If you're tired of dreaming, just wake up.
　Reality isn't so bad after all.」

stage0092_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「What's lost, be it the past or memory, won't return.
　No, maybe none of it ever existed at all.」

stage0092_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But the here and now surely exists.
　Yes... this world you feel right now
　is an undeniable truth.」

stage0092_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This city's the same way.
　...It doesn't matter who built it, or how.
　Paradigm City is alive.」

stage0092_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And the world stretches out endlessly.
　If you don't like the role you've been handed,
　just step off the stage on your own.」

stage0092_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But... I have nowhere to go,
　and neither do the people of this city...」

stage0092_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just ask your own feet.
　Go wherever the wind takes you, wherever your heart
　takes you, and that will be your destination.」

stage0092_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Outside the dome might be wasteland.
　But it's up to you to see for yourself
　what lies beyond it.」

stage0092_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「And what if there's nothing there either?」

stage0092_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then create something with your own hands.」

stage0092_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The past's gone, but you can still build the future...
　If you don't like the role someone chose for you,
　then decide your own role yourself.」

stage0092_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just as I chose my role
　as the world's negotiator.」

stage0092_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If that's what you want, come with us.」

stage0092_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Do I even have the right to that?」

stage0092_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I told you already.
　That's for you to decide.」

stage0092_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The wings you think you've lost
　must still be in your heart.」

stage0092_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Spread those folded wings, $$エンジェル$$.
　You're free.」

stage0092_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Quite poetic, for you.
　Though a bit old-fashioned.」

stage0092_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Isn't that refreshing, though?
　In that sense, the past isn't so bad.」

stage0092_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「That's true...
　At the very least, the time I spent with you
　was irreplaceable to me.」

stage0092_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Even if someone else decided that for me.」

stage0092_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then, from now on, let's build that time with me...
　no, with everyone who hopes for a future.」

stage0092_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Heh... not saying 'the two of us together'
　makes for a failed pick-up line.」

stage0092_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But it wasn't bad.
　$$ロジャー$$, the Negotiator...」

stage0092_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Thank you...
　I... I'll accept this world.」

stage0092_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Let's meet again, $$ロジャー$$.
　Somewhere, in some corner of the world.」

stage0092_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'll be looking forward to that day.」

stage0092_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「No... that's not right.
　$$エンジェル$$ accepted the world.」

stage0092_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Surely, once we're outside this city,
　everyone will be waiting for us.」

stage0092_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why...!?
　Why can you all overcome the fate
　that they decreed!?」

stage0092_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I won't accept this...!
　I refuse to accept a result like this!」

stage0092_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「How pitiful, survivor of the Wings!」

stage0092_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A god of Olympus...!
　So, the King of the Underworld!」

stage0092_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I won't let you have your way with the Earth!
　This planet belongs to us!」

stage0092_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Now then, you Wings!
　I'll show you who rules this world...
　who commands the galaxy!」

stage0092_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Is it time for the finale, then!」

stage0092_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$!」

stage0092_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Soon, you'll all learn the truth of this world!
　Yes...! The existence of the one who governs fate!」

stage0092_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「I'm satisfied, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　The Big's advent, the world's end, the System's
　activation, I saw them all with my own eyes!」

stage0092_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still caught up in illusions, are you...!」

stage0092_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Then, let's give him an ending
　fitting for the Big's Dominus.」

stage0092_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ドロシー#240$$... if you've come, that means...」

stage0092_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「I'm releasing $$ビッグオー$$'s final seal.」

stage0092_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツ$$!
　I'll put an end to your quest for the truth!」

stage0092_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha!
　To think the last sight I'd see
　wouldn't be flames, but light!」

stage0092_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「But this isn't bad!
　Not bad at all!」

stage0092_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$...!
　In the end, you chose to live
　without being bound by memory.」

stage0092_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's not me turning away from your 'truth'.
　I simply never found value in memory... in the past.」

stage0092_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「What I want isn't the past.
　It's the future.」

stage0092_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Hmph... a reporter can't write tomorrow's news.
　From here on, see the truth for yourself.」

stage0092_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Farewell, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　Paint the future with your negotiations!」

stage0092_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$桂$$
「Noisy to the very end, that guy.」

stage0092_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But he lived life his own way, to the end.
　That deserves respect.」

stage0092_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（Farewell, $$シュバルツバルト$$.
　Rest, this time for real.）

stage0092_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ロジャー$$...!
　I'm entrusting the world's survival to you!」

stage0092_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The Quarter...!
　Is it going to disappear!?」

stage0092_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$號$$
「My... my very existence! Is it disappearing!」

stage0092_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$オットー$$
「I-it's really disappearing!
　The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is vanishing!」

stage0092_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So this is the power that erases the world...!」

stage0092_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is as far as I go!
　I'm counting on you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0092_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$さやか$$
「I'm disappearing!
　Venus and I are both disappearing!」

stage0092_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ボス$$
「Whoaaaargh!
　We're really about to disappear!」

stage0092_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Count on you, $$ロジャー$$!
　If I, the president, vanish, my company's done for!」

stage0092_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$柿小路$$
「T-this won't do!
　I can't disappear and leave my family behind...!」

stage0092_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$隼人$$
「My body's being wrapped in light...!」

stage0092_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it!
　I knew it was coming, but it's worse than I imagined!」

stage0092_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$葵$$
「Even I'm at a loss here...
　The rest is up to the negotiator's skill.」

stage0092_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$タケル$$
「I've done everything I could.
　Now it's up to Mr. $$ロジャー$$.」

stage0092_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「N-no good!
　The $$コスモクラッシャー$$'s vanishing!」

stage0092_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$赤木$$
「Hang in there, $$ダイ・ガード$$!
　Grit and guts, just hold on somehow...」

stage0092_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Father... maybe, after this,
　I'll never get to see you again...）

stage0092_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$アスカ$$
「N-no way! We're really disappearing!?
　Me and Unit-02, both of us!!」

stage0092_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$マリ$$
「Haha... you don't get an experience like this every day...」

stage0092_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$シモン$$
「I believe in you, $$ロジャー$$!
　That you'll save us and the world!」

stage0092_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$キタン$$
「Daaaaamn it!!
　Isn't there anything we can dooooo!!」

stage0092_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Wh-what is this!
　What's happening to my body!」

stage0092_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「I-I don't want to think about it, but
　if we really vanish like this...」

stage0092_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ロジャー$$!
　I believe you can make a miracle happen!」

stage0092_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$アルト$$
「If I can never see her again like this,
　then I...!」

stage0092_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well... I knew this might happen, but
　it's still not a pleasant feeling...」

stage0092_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ルカ$$
「I-if I knew it'd come to this,
　I'd have spent more time with Nanase...!」

stage0092_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$ミシェル$$!
　I'm...! The way I feel about you is...」

stage0092_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Eddie...
　If anything happens... live strong, okay...」

stage0092_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Aquarion!
　It's vanishing from this world!」

stage0092_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$桂$$
「Well then... guess I'll leave the rest
　to $$ロジャー$$-sensei...!」

stage0092_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「T-this is as far as I go!
　$$ガムリン・木崎$$, disappearing!」

stage0092_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Whoaaaa!
　I haven't sung nearly enough yet!!」

stage0092_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can't let it end before I learn her true intentions...!」

stage0092_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$リディ$$
「Am I... just a man who ends here!
　No, that can't be...!」

stage0092_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$カツ$$
「N-no! I don't want this!
　I don't want this at all!!」

stage0092_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't let it end before I face him!
　I'm counting on you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0092_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「N-no, not like this!
　$$クェス$$...! $$クェス$$!!」

stage0092_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Swallowed... by the light!
　$$オードリー$$!!」

stage0092_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Even if I vanish, the soul of Echoes will never die!」

stage0092_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$シン$$
「Daaaaamn it!!
　Is there nothing I can do!」

stage0092_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$キラ$$
「$$ロジャー$$!
　I entrust the world's future to you!」

stage0092_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Tch... the reaper's wrapped in light, off to heaven.
　Not exactly a cool way to go...」

stage0092_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$トロワ$$
「...So this is what disappearing feels like...
　I see...」

stage0092_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$カトル$$
「The world... it mustn't be swallowed by this light...!
　$$ロジャー$$, I'm counting on you!」

stage0092_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$五飛$$
「I've done all I can; the rest is up to Heaven...
　The rest, I leave to you, $$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0092_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Dying doesn't scare me...
　But going without seeing where the world ends up... that I regret...」

stage0092_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ノイン$$
「This light is what erases the world...!?」

stage0092_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I'm disappearing...!
　Am I really going to disappear!?」

stage0092_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　She surely must... to you...」

stage0092_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Since I knew, there's no point freaking out about it.
　...The rest's up to you, Mister Negotiator.」

stage0092_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Seriously!? This is nuts!
　This has gotta be a scam!」

stage0092_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「So this is the System's power...
　Can humanity really... defeat something like this...」

stage0092_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$マオ$$
「Quite the rare experience, this...
　Let's hope we can laugh about it later.」

stage0092_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$クルツ$$
「W-wait, hold on!
　I'm not mentally prepared for thiiiis!!」

stage0092_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$宗介$$
「Chidori... I will return, without fail...」

stage0092_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I've done everything I could...
　Now I'll trust in our allies' efforts.」

stage0092_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　I'm wagering the world on your professional pride!」

stage0092_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$スザク$$
「Even if this is as far as I go,
　$c isn't finished yet!
　I'm counting on you for the rest!」

stage0092_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$カレン$$
「I can't let this world end just yet!
　I'm counting on you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0092_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even I have no way to stop this...」

stage0092_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$キリコ$$
（The rest, I leave to you, $$ロジャー$$.）

stage0092_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Is this too a power beyond the ordinary...」

stage0092_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$グラハム$$
「My comrades will carry on my will...!
　The rest, I leave to you!」

stage0092_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「W-wait, wait!
　I'm the Undying $$コーラサワー$$... no, wait,
　now it's the Happy Cola...」

stage0092_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$n
「I understand now...!
　This power too... it's part of the $$次元力$$...」

stage0092_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Its damage has healed again...」

stage0092_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So that's the power of the triangle of hatred he spoke of...!」

stage0092_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's right...
　Wingless one... come to know my anger and sorrow.」

stage0092_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「What will you do, $$ロジャー$$?」

stage0092_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Right now, stopping $$エンジェル$$ takes priority...!
　Settling things with him comes after!」

stage0092_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「We've known each other a good long while now,
　$$シュバルツバルト$$!」

stage0092_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「But that will soon come to an end!
　And then, the truth will be dragged
　into the light of day!」

stage0092_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「And humanity will despair!
　Upon learning this world's true form!」

stage0092_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see.
　So you're the one who tasted despair
　a step ahead of everyone else.」

stage0092_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But there's no need to worry!
　We've overcome despair again and again
　to get to where we are now!」

stage0092_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Don't shut your heart away in loneliness!
　You're not alone!」

stage0092_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You too are one of the people who make up this world!
　Yes... please understand
　this world isn't yours alone!」

stage0092_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$n
（$$ガドライト$$...!
　I will never forget today's humiliation...!
　And I'll make you regret underestimating us...!）

stage0092_04:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$n
（We will surely find the singularity,
　and shatter your scheme...!）

stage0092_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$n
（$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　I'll make you regret this, without fail!）

stage0092_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The Black History...
　We should have avoided that...）

stage0092_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$アムロ$$
（But $$シュバルツ$$ said that Nuclear Winter
　was brought about by $$シャア$$'s own hand...）

stage0092_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$アムロ$$
（What is this chill...!
　What on earth has happened to the world...!）

stage0092_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So $$ミコノ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ are there too!」

stage0092_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Wing dog... and what will you do, knowing that?」

stage0092_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Obviously!
　I'll bring them both back!」

stage0092_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you could only save one of the two,
　what would you do?」

stage0092_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「So, you'll choose that woman again...
　But that's exactly what gives me power.」

stage0092_04:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$アルト$$
「The $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ you took, are they safe!?」

stage0092_04:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And what will you do, knowing that?
　Are you saying you'll save them both?」

stage0092_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ha ha ha, wingless one!
　You are, quite literally, one without wings!」

stage0092_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Your wings are what give me power!
　So that I may kill you, the beloved one!」
